question.text: How many patients will Mendoza's Ministry of Health have confirmed as infected with *Serratia marcescens* in the Hospital Privado outbreak as of November 13, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the cumulative number of patients that the Mendoza provincial Ministry of Health and Sports ([Ministerio de Salud y Deportes de Mendoza](https://www.mendoza.gov.ar/salud/)) has reported as laboratory-confirmed infections with *Serratia marcescens* linked to the outbreak among patients operated at the Hospital Privado de Mendoza, in the most recent official statement, press release, press conference or epidemiological report it issues on or before November 13, 2026 (Mendoza local time, UTC−3). The count is in patients (not isolates) and includes every case the ministry itself classifies as confirmed by laboratory isolation, whatever the infection site (meningitis, bloodstream or surgical-site) and including confirmed patients who have since died; patients the ministry classifies as suspected, probable, "under study" or discarded are not counted, and the ministry's own classification governs. A press figure counts only when it is presented as the ministry's number of laboratory-confirmed infections — speculative totals that "would" be reached if pending cases are confirmed do not count. If no new official statement is issued ahead of the cutoff, the last official figure the ministry published on or before November 13, 2026 applies. Where officials give conflicting figures on the same day, the figure in the ministry's own written statement or post published at mendoza.gov.ar governs; absent one, the figure accompanied by the most detailed breakdown by infection site is used. As an example, a figure of seven confirmed patients resolves as "7".
question.fine_print: Counts published by the ministry after November 13, 2026 (Mendoza local time) do not affect resolution. If the ministry's most recent update gives separate figures by infection type without stating a total, the laboratory-confirmed subgroups are summed. If the ministry reports only a combined case count without separating confirmed from suspected cases, the last figure at which it explicitly stated laboratory-confirmed cases governs. If the ministry's total spans more than one facility or a wider product-linked investigation, only the confirmed patients it links to the Hospital Privado de Mendoza are counted. If the ministry reclassifies a previously confirmed patient (for example, discarding a case), the most recent classification as of November 13, 2026 governs. Figures issued by the Hospital Privado de Mendoza itself, or by national or international bodies, are not used where they conflict with the provincial ministry's figures.

## Research brief: confirmed *S. marcescens* patients in the Hospital Privado de Mendoza outbreak

The latest figure I found is **5 laboratory-confirmed patients**, unchanged since October 27. I found no official statement or press report on the case count dated October 31 to November 2.

### 1. Resolution source
- I could not read the ministry's own press page. The search for "site:mendoza.gov.ar" returned no ministry pages, and the original release on prensa.mendoza.gob.ar returned HTTP 403. The case counts below are ministry figures as reported by the press. [prensa.mendoza.gob.ar](https://prensa.mendoza.gob.ar/el-ministerio-de-salud-dispuso-el-cierre-preventivo-de-quirofanos-de-un-hospital-privado-ante-un-brote-de-meningitis-posquirurgica/)
- 2026-10-30: La Nación's most recent ministry-attributed breakdown: 10 patients under study, 5 confirmed (2 of them died), 2 suspected (both dead, no microbiological confirmation), 3 discarded. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-familiares-de-pacientes-fueron-a-la-justicia-para-exigir-que-se-nid30102026/)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The working value is 5.
- The pending pool looks smaller than the question background suggests:
  - La Nación (Oct 28) said that if the bacterium were found in the two patients under investigation, the totals would rise to 7 infected and 4 deaths. That arithmetic suggests the "two possible new cases" are the two deceased suspected patients, not extra patients. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-crece-la-incertidumbre-sobre-el-origen-y-analizan-nuevos-casos-nid28102026/)
  - The Oct 30 La Nación breakdown lists 2 suspected and 3 discarded, compared with 3 suspected and 2 discarded on Oct 27-29. This suggests one suspected patient was discarded. I have not verified this against a ministry text.
- Infobae (Oct 29) says the two later deaths have no microbiological confirmation. Since those patients are dead, new laboratory confirmation may be hard to obtain. That is my inference, not a ministry statement. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2026/10/29/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-investigan-dos-fallecimientos-mas-en-el-hospital-privado/)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-30:
  - A prosecutor, Gustavo Stroppiana, is handling a criminal complaint filed by the daughters of a hospitalised patient, as a "fact-finding" case with no one charged. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-familiares-de-pacientes-fueron-a-la-justicia-para-exigir-que-se-nid30102026/)
  - Results of operating-room cultures are still pending.
  - The link between the fifth confirmed case (a patient operated on in September) and the other cases is still being studied.
- 2026-10-29: Of the confirmed patients, 3 had meningitis confirmed in cerebrospinal fluid, 1 had a blood isolate and 1 had a surgical-site infection. Two are in intensive care and one is on a general ward. Isolates were sent to the Instituto Malbrán for genotyping, and I found no results yet. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2026/10/29/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-investigan-dos-fallecimientos-mas-en-el-hospital-privado/)
- 2026-10-28: Falaschi, the epidemiology director, said: "pensamos que ya no vamos a tener más pacientes afectados" ("we think there will be no more affected patients"), because these infections appear soon after surgery. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-crece-la-incertidumbre-sobre-el-origen-y-analizan-nuevos-casos-nid28102026/)
- 2026-10-27: Fifth case confirmed; 10 patients under investigation (5 confirmed, 3 suspected, 2 discarded). [Sitio Andino](https://www.sitioandino.com.ar/salud/brote-meningitis-mendoza-se-confirmo-un-nuevo-caso-y-son-diez-los-pacientes-investigados-n5732665), [MDZ](https://www.mdzol.com/sociedad/2026/10/27/confirmaron-un-nuevo-caso-de-meningitis-que-se-sabe-y-como-estan-los-pacientes-1991085.html), [Diario UNO](https://www.diariouno.com.ar/sociedad/meningitis-posquirurgica-confirmaron-el-quinto-contagio-y-son-10-los-casos-que-se-investigan-n1610487)
- 2026-10-24: 4 confirmed, 2 deaths, operating rooms closed. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2026/10/24/mendoza-cerro-los-quirofanos-de-un-hospital-por-un-brote-de-meningitis-posquirurgica-murieron-dos-pacientes/)
- 2026-10-31: La Gaceta was still reporting "four confirmed", an outdated figure. Syndicated reports can lag, so they should not be read as a downward revision. [La Gaceta](https://www.lagaceta.com.ar/nota/1160441/sociedad/brote-meningitis-mendoza-dos-personas-fallecieron-se-investigan-causas.html)

### 4. Base rates and trend
- The confirmed count went 4 (Oct 24) → 5 (Oct 27). There has been no change in about 6 days (Oct 27 to Nov 2), and the number of suspected patients appears to have fallen from 3 to 2.
- For comparison, post-surgical *Serratia* clusters traced to a single operating-room source usually stay small (single digits) once surgery stops. This is general knowledge, not a systematic base rate I found.
- Plausible additions:
  - The 2 deceased suspected patients, if microbiological evidence is found.
  - Late-presenting surgical-site infections, since the September case shows the exposure window may be wider than October.

### 5. Other forecasts
- None of the supplied Kalshi or Polymarket markets match this question; they cover Fernando Mendoza (an NFL player), JoAnna Mendoza (a US House candidate), hantavirus, measles and cyclosporiasis.
- I found no prediction market or expert forecast on this outbreak.

### 6. Upcoming events before November 13
- Malbrán genotyping results, which could tie in or exclude the September case or other isolates.
- Results of the operating-room environmental cultures.
- Any ministry decision to reopen the operating rooms, likely with a wrap-up statement.
- Possible post-mortem microbiology on the two suspected deceased patients.
- Further steps in the prosecutor's case.
- The ministry may simply stop issuing updates. In that case the last published figure, currently 5, would apply.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: I couldn't read the ministry's press site directly. mendoza.gov.ar/prensa redirects to prensa.mendoza.gob.ar, and that site returned HTTP 403. A site search turned up only unrelated COVID-era posts, so I found no written ministry statement about the outbreak on the government site. [mendoza.gov.ar redirect](https://www.mendoza.gov.ar/prensa/?s=meningitis)
- 2026-10-27: The latest official figure, as reproduced by the press, comes from the Dirección de Epidemiología: **5 patients confirmed** with *Serratia marcescens*. That is 3 meningitis cases confirmed in cerebrospinal fluid, 1 blood isolate with clinical suspicion of meningitis, and 1 surgical-site infection after a September operation (that patient has been discharged). Of 10 patients analysed, 3 were suspected and 2 discarded. Two confirmed patients are in intensive care and 1 is on a general ward. [Sitio Andino](https://www.sitioandino.com.ar/salud/brote-meningitis-mendoza-se-confirmo-un-nuevo-caso-y-son-diez-los-pacientes-investigados-n5732665), [Diario Uno](https://www.diariouno.com.ar/sociedad/meningitis-posquirurgica-confirmaron-el-quinto-contagio-y-son-10-los-casos-que-se-investigan-n1610487)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The official confirmed count has been 5 since about October 27, and I found no report of a sixth confirmed case.
- 2026-10-28: The "two possible additional cases" that would bring the total to 7 are **the two deaths under investigation**, not new living patients. La Nación wrote that if *Serratia* were confirmed in them, the totals "would" rise to 7 infected and 4 deaths. Under the resolution criteria, that conditional total does not count. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-crece-la-incertidumbre-sobre-el-origen-y-analizan-nuevos-casos-nid28102026/)
- 2026-10-30: La Nación's breakdown of the 10 patients was 5 confirmed (2 of them died), 2 suspected deaths without microbiological confirmation, and 3 negative. Compared with the October 27 split (3 suspected, 2 discarded), this suggests one suspected patient was discarded, so the pending pool now looks like just the 2 deceased patients. That is my reading of the press figures, not something the ministry has said. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-familiares-de-pacientes-fueron-a-la-justicia-para-exigir-que-se-nid30102026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-31: La Gaceta still cited four confirmed cases and two deaths. This looks like recycled early figures. [La Gaceta](https://www.lagaceta.com.ar/nota/1160441/sociedad/brote-meningitis-mendoza-dos-personas-fallecieron-se-investigan-causas.html)
- 2026-10-30: Patients' families went to court. Operating-room cultures and the Malbrán Institute's results were still pending. The suspension of surgery had not been reported lifted. [La Nación](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/sociedad/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-familiares-de-pacientes-fueron-a-la-justicia-para-exigir-que-se-nid30102026/)
- 2026-10-29: Salud Mendoza gave Infobae the same breakdown of 5 confirmed. The two recent deaths stay "suspected" for lack of microbiological confirmation. Falaschi discussed the hypotheses being considered on Radio Mitre. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2026/10/29/brote-de-meningitis-en-mendoza-investigan-dos-fallecimientos-mas-en-el-hospital-privado/)
- 2026-10-27/28: Los Andes reported "5 infectados confirmados y 4 decesos en estudio". [Los Andes](https://www.losandes.com.ar/sociedad/diez-pacientes-lupa-el-brote-meningitis-hay-5-infectados-confirmados-y-4-decesos-estudio-n6011981)
- 2026-10-26: A criminal complaint was filed (case P-114310/26, Unidad Fiscal Correccional). [MDZ](https://www.mdzol.com/sociedad/2026/10/26/meningitis-en-mendoza-la-justicia-ya-investiga-el-brote-en-el-hospital-privado-1990859.html)
- 2026-10-24: The count was 4 confirmed and 2 deaths, and surgery was suspended. [Infobae](https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2026/10/24/mendoza-cerro-los-quirofanos-de-un-hospital-por-un-brote-de-meningitis-posquirurgica-murieron-dos-pacientes/)
- I found no updates dated October 31 to November 2 with new counts. The searches suggest news coverage has slowed.

## 4. Base rates
- Trajectory of the confirmed count: 4 on October 24, 5 on October 27, then 5 through at least October 30. That is one revision in about 6 days, followed by roughly 6 days with no change.
- The two pending patients have died. Confirming them now would depend on samples or cultures already taken, so they might stay "suspected" indefinitely.
- With surgery suspended since about October 21-24, new exposures should be very limited. Late cases could still appear among patients operated in October. The ministry asked those patients to come forward if they have symptoms.
- Even with a fixed exposure window, published *Serratia* outbreaks traced to contaminated solutions often keep finding a few late or retrospective cases, for example by reviewing earlier operations like the September case. I did not find a quantitative base rate specific to this kind of outbreak.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets supplied match this question. They cover hantavirus, Fernando Mendoza in the NFL, the AZ-06 race and measles. I found no prediction market or expert forecast on this outbreak's case count.

## 6. Upcoming events before November 13
- The Malbrán Institute's genotyping of the isolates. It could link or unlink the September surgical-site case, which might lead the ministry to reclassify it.
- Results of the operating-room environmental cultures and of the samples of medicines, antiseptics and supplies.
- The microbiological workup of the 2 suspected deaths.
- Possible new patients from the October surgical cohort coming forward.
- A possible decision to reopen the operating rooms, likely with a ministry update attached.
- The court case, which could bring more information to light.
- Updates come out irregularly through the press, not on a dashboard. If none is issued, the last figure (5) stands.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 11.5 days, from November 2 to the cutoff on November 13, 2026 (Mendoza time).

(b) **Latest known value:** 5 laboratory-confirmed patients. This is the ministry figure reported by the press since October 27, and La Nación repeated it on October 30 with the breakdown 5 confirmed, 2 suspected (both deceased), 3 discarded.

(c) **If nothing changes:** 5.

(d) **If the current trend continues:** 5. The count rose by one in the first week (4 to 5 by October 27) and has not moved for six days. Surgery is suspended, and the suspected pool appears to have shrunk from 3 to 2. The epidemiology director said she expects no more affected patients.

(e) **Historical variation:** Over 11 days at this stage of a contained post-surgical cluster, the count typically moves by 0 to 2. The main upside is the 2 deceased suspected patients. Post-mortem or stored-sample microbiology could confirm them, but confirmation is hard without existing isolates. There is also a small chance of a late surgical-site infection, since the September case shows exposure may have started earlier. The downside is reclassification: if Malbrán genotyping does not tie the September case to the cluster, it could be dropped, giving 4.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There are no markets on this outbreak. Ministry officials say expansion has been ruled out and that no new affected patients are expected.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Genotyping shows the September surgical-site isolate, and perhaps the blood isolate, are unrelated strains, and the ministry removes them, leaving 3 or 4.
- **High:** Operating-room cultures identify a contaminated supply that was used more widely, for example since August. A retrospective case search then finds further culture-positive surgical-site and bloodstream infections, and the two deceased suspected patients are confirmed, giving 8 to 10.

The two tails, named before setting them:
- **Percentile 1 (3.5):** This reflects the case where genotyping excludes two of the five confirmed patients.
- **Percentile 99 (9):** This reflects the retrospective case search described above.

I put about 70% probability on the count staying at exactly 5, about 22% on 6 or more, and about 7% on 4 or fewer. Small decimal steps keep the percentiles strictly increasing.

- **High outcome:** Stored samples confirm both deceased suspected patients, giving 7. In addition, a retrospective review of September and October surgeries finds late surgical-site or bloodstream infections, pushing the count to 8 or 9.
